scope: Selected bipolar DC terminal currents, turn-on, KCL and pin faults; all 29 bundled bipolar symbols are exercised with the explicitly listed package/runtime combinations. No full envelope, AC/noise, RF, thermal or physical qualification.

conditions.scope: Selected integration points; off-region points are not assertions of model-characterization validity. NX changes emitter geometry; no independent-parallel scaling claim. Five-terminal HBT thermal ports are clamped to zero temperature rise.

sky130_correction.change: Add exact public NPN t/s/f corner parameters to the separate resistor-corrected package. Existing NPN model coefficients and model bytes remain unchanged; notices and original source files are retained.
sky130_correction.other_corners: Explicitly rejected; no mixed/mismatch/Monte Carlo mapping is guessed.

ihp_runtime.scope: Exact separately built public ngspice 47 diagnostic binary. Three hot NPN cases fail with default ngspice 42 and pass here; default release integration is still required.

cross_runtime_diagnostic.scope: A separate strict cross-version audit; 12 cases exceed this tolerance. The new engine is not claimed numerically interchangeable with the old engine. Each engine-specific independent-call comparison retains its own result.

diagnostics: Initial IHP NPN pilot used an incorrect fixture length override for npn13G2l_5t, caught by independent reference comparison; explicit length assignment fixed the fixture.
The original 144-case batch has 21 failures: 18 SKY130 NPN missing-corner failures and three IHP NPN thermal/convergence failures at 85 C and 0.6 V.
The first Linux test preparation assumed a tests/__init__.py file; it stopped before tests. Copying the existing test module then produced five passing tests.
remaining: Full source-defined geometry/bias/reliability/temperature envelopes and parameter boundary enforcement.
AC, transient, noise, mismatch, RF and self-heating/thermal-port behavior; physical layout and extracted terminal connectivity across bipolar families.
Default package and simulator integration, complete runtime regression and installed-app acceptance; old NPN/runtime failures remain visible.
Cross-version numerical differences require explicit runtime qualification; no tolerance was relaxed to turn them into passes.
Other MOS/passive/diode/RF families, unsupported required devices, upstream completeness and chunks 8-12.
